note: Original recipes. Quantities are for the stated number of servings. 'photo' is a path inside docs/, e.g. photos/butter-chicken.jpg. Leave it null for a placeholder.

recipes.name: Butter chicken with rice
recipes.blurb: A mild, creamy curry that is easy to make with pantry spices.
method: Rinse the rice, then cook it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt until tender, about 12 minutes. Keep covered.
Melt the butter in a large deep pan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder and garam masala and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chicken and turn it in the spices until it is no longer pink on the outside, about 4 minutes.
Pour in the tomatoes and 100 ml water, season with salt, and simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the cream and simmer for 5 more minutes until glossy. Taste and add salt if needed. Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
recipes.blurb: The weeknight classic. Freezes well.
method: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the mince, breaking it up with a spoon, and cook until browned all over, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, then the tomatoes, herbs, salt and pepper. Simmer on low for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick.
Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water following the packet time. Reserve a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Toss the pasta through the sauce, loosening with a splash of the pasta water if needed. Serve with the parmesan.

recipes.name: Chicken fried rice
recipes.blurb: Uses up leftover rice and a bag of frozen veg.
method: Cook the rice, spread it on a tray and let it cool for at least 20 minutes. Cold rice fries much better than hot rice.
Heat half the oil in a large pan or wok over high heat. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through, then move it to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the garlic and ginger, and stir for 30 seconds. Tip in the frozen vegetables and cook for 3 minutes.
Push everything to the side, crack in the eggs and scramble them until just set.
Add the rice and chicken, pour over the soy sauce, and toss over high heat for 3 minutes until hot and lightly crisp.

recipes.name: Soft beef tacos
recipes.blurb: Cheap, fast and easy for kids to build themselves.
method: Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the mince and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the chilli, cumin, paprika and tomato paste with 100 ml water. Simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce clings to the meat.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds each side, or wrapped in foil in the oven.
Mash the avocado with a pinch of salt. Fill each tortilla with mince, avocado, tomato, lettuce and cheese.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken and mushroom pasta
method: Boil the pasta in salted water following the packet time. Drain, keeping a little of the water.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
In the same pan cook the onion and mushrooms for 6 minutes until the mushrooms are golden. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and cream and simmer for 4 minutes until slightly thickened.
Return the chicken to the pan, add the pasta and spinach, and toss until the spinach wilts. Stir through the parmesan and loosen with pasta water if needed.

recipes.name: Sausage and vegetable tray bake
recipes.blurb: One tray, minimal washing up.
method: Heat the oven to 220 C (200 C fan). Put the potato and carrot on a large tray with the oil, herbs and salt and toss well.
Roast for 15 minutes. Add the onion, capsicum and sausages to the tray and turn everything over.
Roast for another 25 to 30 minutes, turning once, until the sausages are browned and cooked through and the potatoes are crisp at the edges.

recipes.name: Honey soy salmon with rice and broccoli
method: Cook the rice. Mix the soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger and the juice of half the lemon in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Cook the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, turn, and cook for 2 more minutes.
Pour the sauce over the salmon and let it bubble for 1 minute, spooning it over the fish.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 3 to 4 minutes until bright green and just tender.
Serve the salmon over the rice with the broccoli and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Vegetable stir fry noodles
method: Prepare the noodles as the packet says, drain and rinse under cold water.
Mix the soy sauce and honey with 3 tablespoons of water.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Stir fry the carrot and broccoli for 3 minutes, then add the capsicum and mushrooms for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the noodles and sauce. Toss for 2 to 3 minutes until everything is hot and glossy.

recipes.name: Chicken caesar salad
method: Heat the oven to 200 C. Toss the bread cubes with 1 tablespoon of oil and a pinch of salt and bake for 10 minutes until golden.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Cook in a pan with a little oil for 5 to 6 minutes each side until cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve. Fry the bacon until crisp.
Whisk the remaining oil, the juice of the lemon, garlic and half the parmesan for the dressing.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, then top with the chicken, bacon, eggs, croutons and remaining parmesan.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli stir fry
method: Cook the rice. Toss the beef with the cornflour and a tablespoon of the soy sauce. Mix the remaining soy sauce with the honey and 100 ml water.
Heat half the oil in a wok until very hot. Stir fry the beef in two batches for 1 to 2 minutes until browned, and set aside.
Add the remaining oil and cook the broccoli for 3 minutes with a splash of water. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until it thickens. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Cottage pie
method: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes until soft. Drain, mash with the butter and milk, and season.
Meanwhile cook the onion and carrot in a large oven-proof pan for 6 minutes. Add the mince and brown it for 8 minutes.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste, then the stock. Simmer for 15 minutes until thick, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes. Season.
Heat the oven to 200 C. Spoon the mash over the mince, rough it up with a fork and scatter with the cheese.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Ham and cheese omelette
method: Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Melt a quarter of the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour in a quarter of the egg mixture and swirl.
When the base is set but the top is still slightly wet, scatter over a quarter of the ham, cheese and spinach.
Fold the omelette in half, slide it onto a plate and repeat for the others.

recipes.name: Roast pumpkin soup
recipes.blurb: Swap the stock for vegetable stock to make it vegetarian.
method: Heat the oven to 200 C. Roast the pumpkin with a little oil and salt for 30 minutes until soft and golden.
Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the roasted pumpkin and the stock, bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth, stir through the cream and season to taste. Serve with toasted bread.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle soup
method: Put the stock, chicken, onion, carrot, garlic, ginger and salt in a large pot. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 to 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift the chicken out, shred it with two forks and return it to the pot.
Add the noodles and cook for the time on the packet. Taste and adjust the salt, then serve.

recipes.name: Baked mac and cheese
method: Cook the pasta 2 minutes short of the packet time, then drain.
Melt the butter in a pot, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
Take off the heat and stir in three quarters of the cheese, the salt and pepper. Fold in the pasta and peas.
Tip into a baking dish, top with the remaining cheese and bake at 200 C for 15 to 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Margherita flatbread pizzas
method: Heat the oven to 220 C. Place the flatbreads on trays and brush lightly with oil.
Mix the tomato paste with 2 tablespoons of water and spread over the flatbreads.
Top with the mozzarella, tomato slices and ham if using.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and the edges are crisp. Scatter with basil.

recipes.name: Chilli con carne
recipes.blurb: Better the next day. Freezes well.
method: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion and capsicum for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the mince and brown it for 8 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in the tomato paste, tomatoes, drained beans, salt and 150 ml water. Simmer with the lid slightly off for 35 to 40 minutes until thick.
Cook the rice and serve the chilli on top.

recipes.name: Honey soy chicken thighs
method: Whisk the honey, soy sauce, garlic and ginger. Pour over the chicken and marinate for 15 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 C. Arrange the chicken on a lined tray, pour over the marinade and roast for 30 to 35 minutes, basting once, until sticky and cooked through.
Cook the rice and steam the broccoli. Serve the chicken with the pan juices spooned over.

recipes.name: Zucchini and cheese fritters
method: Toss the grated zucchini with half the salt and leave for 10 minutes. Squeeze out as much liquid as you can in a clean tea towel.
Mix the zucchini with the eggs, flour, baking powder, cheese and remaining salt.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Drop in heaped spoonfuls and flatten slightly. Cook 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with the yoghurt and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Creamy tuna pasta bake
method: Heat the oven to 200 C. Cook the pasta 2 minutes short of the packet time and drain.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and cream. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tuna, peas and pasta and tip into a baking dish.
Scatter with the cheese and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Sausages, mash and onion gravy
method: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Brown the sausages in a pan with the oil, turning, for about 12 minutes until cooked through. Remove and keep warm.
In the same pan cook the onions for 10 minutes until soft and golden. Stir in the flour, then gradually add the stock and simmer for 5 minutes until thick.
Cook the peas, and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Homemade beef burgers
method: Mix the mince with the grated onion, egg, salt and pepper. Shape into 4 patties slightly wider than the buns and chill for 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the patties for 4 to 5 minutes each side until cooked through, adding the cheese for the last minute.
Toast the buns, then fill with lettuce, tomato, onion and the patties.

recipes.name: Scrambled eggs and avocado on toast
method: Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper. Toast the bread.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over low heat, add the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula for 3 to 4 minutes until softly set.
Mash the avocado with a pinch of salt and spread over the toast. Top with the eggs.

recipes.name: Banana pancakes
method: Mix the flour, baking powder and sugar in a bowl. Whisk the eggs, milk and 30 g of the melted butter, then stir into the dry mix until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with a little of the remaining butter. Pour in 1/4 cup of batter per pancake.
Cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear, flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more. Repeat with the rest.
Serve with the banana and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Spiced chicken wraps
method: Toss the chicken with the paprika, oil, salt and the juice of half the lemon. Cook in a hot pan for 6 to 8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Stir the garlic and a squeeze of lemon into the yoghurt for the sauce.
Warm the tortillas, spread with the yoghurt sauce and fill with the chicken, lettuce, tomato and cheese. Roll up and serve.

recipes.name: Banana and honey porridge
method: Put the oats, milk and salt in a pot and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Spoon into bowls and top with the banana and honey.

recipes.name: Chickpea and spinach coconut curry
recipes.blurb: Vegan as written.
method: Cook the rice. Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Taste, adjust the salt, and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Kung pao chicken
recipes.blurb: Sichuan-style chicken stir fry with peanuts, chilli and a glossy sweet and sour sauce.

ingredients.note: sliced (or a handful of dried chillies)

method: Rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.
Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine and half the cornflour.
Mix the sauce: the rest of the soy sauce, the vinegar, sugar, the rest of the cornflour and 3 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until browned and cooked through. Lift it out.
Add the chilli, garlic, ginger and the white parts of the spring onion and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce and toss for about a minute until thick and glossy. Stir through the peanuts and the green spring onion and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Mapo tofu
recipes.blurb: Soft tofu in a spicy, savoury pork and chilli bean sauce. A Sichuan classic that comes together fast.

ingredients.note: soft or firm, cut into 2 cm cubes

method: Rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.
Simmer the tofu cubes in lightly salted water for 2 minutes to firm them up, then drain.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat and fry the pork, breaking it up, for about 4 minutes until browned.
Add the chilli bean paste, garlic, ginger and chilli powder and fry for a minute until the oil turns red.
Pour in the stock, soy sauce and sugar and bring to a simmer. Slide in the tofu and simmer for 4 minutes, nudging it gently rather than stirring.

Mix the cornflour with 2 tbsp water, stir it in gently and simmer until the sauce thickens. Scatter over the spring onion and serve over rice. Ground Sichuan pepper on top is traditional if you have it.

recipes.name: Tomato and egg stir fry
recipes.blurb: Soft scrambled egg and juicy tomato in a light sweet-savoury sauce. Everyday home cooking in China.
method: Rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of the salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high heat, pour in the eggs and stir gently until just set in large soft curds. Tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and the tomatoes and stir-fry for about 3 minutes until they soften and release their juice.
Add the sugar, the rest of the salt and 3 tbsp water and simmer for 2 minutes.
Return the eggs and fold everything together for 30 seconds. Drizzle with sesame oil, scatter over the spring onion and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Char siu pork with rice and greens
recipes.blurb: Sticky, sweet roast pork glazed with hoisin and honey. Marinate for at least an hour, or overnight.

ingredients.note: or pork shoulder, cut into strips 4 cm thick

method: Mix the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, 2 tbsp of the honey, the five spice, garlic, wine and sugar. Coat the pork and marinate in the fridge for at least an hour.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a roasting tray with foil and set a rack on it. Lay the pork on the rack and keep the leftover marinade.
Roast for 25 minutes, turn the pork, brush with the leftover marinade and roast for another 20 minutes.
Brush with the rest of the honey and roast for 5 to 10 minutes more until sticky and charred at the edges and cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.
Stir-fry the bok choy in the oil over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes with a splash of water and a pinch of salt. Serve the pork over rice with the greens.

recipes.name: Chinese steamed egg custard
recipes.blurb: Silky, savoury egg custard steamed in a bowl. Serve with rice and a stir fry.
method: Beat the eggs gently so you do not whip in air, then whisk in the warm stock and salt.
Pour through a sieve into a shallow heatproof dish and skim off any bubbles. Cover with a plate or foil.
Steam over gently simmering water for 10 to 12 minutes until just set and still wobbly in the middle. A knife pushed into the centre should come out clean.
Drizzle with the soy sauce and sesame oil and scatter over the spring onion.

recipes.name: Pork and cabbage dumplings
recipes.blurb: Homemade jiaozi with a simple flour and water dough. Makes about 40, and extras freeze well.
method: Mix the flour with 150 ml cold water and knead for 5 minutes until smooth. Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Toss the cabbage with the salt, leave for 10 minutes, then squeeze out as much water as you can.
Mix the pork, cabbage, spring onion, ginger, 1 tbsp of the soy sauce, the sesame oil, wine and 2 tbsp water, stirring in one direction until sticky.
Roll the dough into a long rope, cut it into 40 pieces and roll each into a thin circle about 8 cm across.
Put a heaped teaspoon of filling in the middle of each, fold in half and pinch the edges firmly to seal.
Boil in batches in a large pot of water. When they float, add a cup of cold water and bring back to the boil; do this twice, about 6 to 7 minutes in all, until the filling is cooked through.
Serve with the vinegar mixed with the rest of the soy sauce for dipping. Freeze any extras uncooked on a tray, then bag them.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour chicken
recipes.blurb: Crisp chicken pieces tossed with capsicum and onion in a tangy homemade sauce.
method: Rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.
Mix the sauce: vinegar, sugar, tomato paste, soy sauce, 1 tbsp of the cornflour and 150 ml water.
Beat the egg. Dip the chicken in the egg, then toss it in the rest of the cornflour.
Shallow-fry the chicken in the oil over medium-high heat in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towels.
Pour off all but 1 tbsp of the oil. Stir-fry the onion and capsicum for 3 minutes, then the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes until thick and glossy. Toss the chicken through and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Dan dan noodles
recipes.blurb: Noodles with crisp spiced pork, greens and a nutty, tangy chilli sauce. Toss everything before eating.
method: Divide the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, chilli powder and garlic between four bowls.
Fry the pork in the oil over medium-high heat with the chilli bean paste and wine for about 6 minutes until browned and crisp at the edges.
Cook the noodles as the packet says, adding the bok choy for the last minute. Stir 2 tbsp of the hot cooking water into each bowl of sauce, then drain the noodles.
Divide the noodles and greens between the bowls, top with the pork, peanuts and spring onion, and toss well before eating.

recipes.name: Fish-fragrant eggplant
recipes.blurb: Silky eggplant in a sweet, sour and spicy garlic sauce. There is no fish in it: the name comes from a Sichuan sauce once used for fish.

ingredients.note: sliced, white and green kept apart

method: Rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.
Toss the eggplant with the salt, leave for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Fry the eggplant in 2 tbsp of the oil over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes until soft and golden. Lift it out.
Add the rest of the oil and fry the pork until browned. Add the chilli bean paste, garlic, ginger and white spring onion and fry for a minute.
Mix the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, cornflour and 100 ml water, pour it in and bring to a simmer.
Return the eggplant and simmer for 2 minutes until the sauce coats it. Scatter over the green spring onion and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Hot and sour soup
recipes.blurb: A warming soup with tofu, mushroom and egg ribbons, sharp with vinegar and hot with pepper.

ingredients.note: white pepper if you have it

method: Bring the stock to the boil with the ginger and mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, soy sauce, vinegar and pepper and simmer for 2 minutes.
Mix the cornflour with 4 tbsp water, stir it in and simmer for a minute until slightly thickened.
Turn the heat to low and pour in the beaten eggs in a thin stream while stirring slowly, so they set in ribbons.
Taste and add more vinegar or pepper if you like. Finish with the sesame oil and spring onion.

recipes.name: Teriyaki chicken rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Pan-fried chicken thighs in a glossy homemade teriyaki sauce, over rice with broccoli.
method: Rinse the rice until the water runs almost clear. Put it in a pot with 1.2 times its volume of water, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave it covered off the heat for 10 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, mirin and sugar.
Fry the chicken in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes, turn and cook for 5 minutes more until cooked through.
Pour off the fat, add the sauce and let it bubble for 2 to 3 minutes, turning the chicken, until glossy and sticky.
Boil or steam the broccoli for 3 minutes.
Slice the chicken and serve over the rice with the broccoli. Spoon over the sauce and top with spring onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Chicken katsu curry
recipes.blurb: Crisp panko-crumbed chicken with a mild, thick Japanese curry sauce and rice.
method: Rinse the rice until the water runs almost clear. Put it in a pot with 1.2 times its volume of water, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave it covered off the heat for 10 minutes.
Curry: soften the onion in 1 tbsp of the oil for 5 minutes. Add the carrot, potato and 700 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Turn off the heat, break in the curry roux and stir until it melts, then simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Season the chicken, dust it in the flour, dip it in the beaten eggs and press it into the panko.
Shallow-fry in the rest of the oil over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes a side until golden and cooked through. Drain and slice.
Serve the chicken on the rice with the curry sauce alongside.

recipes.name: Teriyaki tofu rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Crisp tofu in sticky teriyaki sauce with rice and vegetables.
method: Rinse the rice until the water runs almost clear. Put it in a pot with 1.2 times its volume of water, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave it covered off the heat for 10 minutes.
Press the tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes, cut it into cubes and toss it in the cornflour.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat, turning, for about 8 minutes until crisp all over.
Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sugar, ginger and 2 tbsp water, pour it over the tofu and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until sticky.
Steam or boil the broccoli and carrot for 3 minutes.
Serve the tofu and vegetables over the rice with the spring onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Oyakodon (chicken and egg rice bowl)
recipes.blurb: Chicken and onion simmered in a sweet soy broth, set with soft egg and spooned over rice.
method: Rinse the rice until the water runs almost clear. Put it in a pot with 1.2 times its volume of water, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave it covered off the heat for 10 minutes.
Bring the stock, soy sauce, mirin and sugar to a simmer in a wide frying pan. Add the onion and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through.

Beat the eggs lightly so they stay streaky. Pour two thirds over the chicken, cover and cook on low for 1 minute, then add the rest, cover and cook for 30 seconds more so the egg is just set but still soft.
Spoon the chicken, egg and some of the broth over bowls of rice and top with spring onion. Japanese cooks use dashi stock; chicken stock works well at home.

recipes.name: Chicken karaage (Japanese fried chicken)
recipes.blurb: Juicy chicken marinated in soy, ginger and garlic, fried until crisp. Serve with lemon, cabbage and rice.
method: Mix the chicken with the soy sauce, mirin, ginger and garlic and leave for 20 minutes.

Rinse the rice until the water runs almost clear. Put it in a pot with 1.2 times its volume of water, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave it covered off the heat for 10 minutes.
Toss the chicken in the cornflour and shake off the excess.
Heat 2 to 3 cm of oil in a heavy pan to about 170°C. Fry the chicken in batches for 4 to 5 minutes until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack. Never leave hot oil unattended.
For extra crunch, fry each batch again for 1 minute once all the chicken is done.
Serve with lemon wedges, the shredded cabbage and rice.

recipes.name: Okonomiyaki (cabbage pancakes)
recipes.blurb: Savoury cabbage pancakes topped with bacon and a sweet-savoury sauce.
method: Whisk the flour, stock, eggs and salt into a thick batter. Fold in the cabbage and most of the spring onion.
Heat a little oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Spoon in a quarter of the batter and shape it into a round about 2 cm thick.
Lay a few bacon slices on top. Cook for about 5 minutes until golden underneath, flip and cook for 5 minutes more until cooked through. Repeat with the rest.
Mix the tomato paste, soy sauce, honey and 1 tbsp water and brush it over the pancakes.
Top with the rest of the spring onion, and Japanese mayonnaise if you like.

recipes.name: Yaki udon (stir-fried udon noodles)
recipes.blurb: Thick udon noodles stir-fried with bacon, cabbage and mushrooms in a soy and mirin sauce.
method: Loosen the udon in hot water for a minute, or cook dried udon as the packet says, then drain.
Fry the bacon in the oil over medium-high heat until golden. Add the onion, carrot and mushrooms and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then the cabbage for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and mirin and toss over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until hot and coated.
Finish with the sesame oil and spring onion.

recipes.name: Gyudon (beef and onion rice bowl)
recipes.blurb: Thin beef and soft onion simmered in a sweet soy broth over rice.
method: Rinse the rice until the water runs almost clear. Put it in a pot with 1.2 times its volume of water, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave it covered off the heat for 10 minutes.
Simmer the stock, soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger in a pan. Add the onion and simmer for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the beef, separating the slices, and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until just cooked. Skim off any foam.
If you like, boil the eggs for 6 and a half minutes, cool them in cold water and peel.
Spoon the beef, onion and some of the broth over the rice and top with spring onion and a halved egg.

recipes.name: Tamagoyaki (rolled omelette)
recipes.blurb: A lightly sweet omelette rolled in layers, sliced and served warm or cold.
method: Beat the eggs with the sugar, soy sauce, mirin, salt and 2 tbsp water without making them frothy.
Heat a small frying pan (square is ideal) over medium-low heat and wipe it with oiled paper towel.
Pour in a thin layer of egg and tilt to cover the pan. When it is almost set but still wet on top, roll it up from the far side towards you.
Push the roll to the far side, wipe the pan with oil again and pour in another thin layer, lifting the roll so egg runs underneath. Roll back up.
Repeat until all the egg is used. Rest the omelette for 2 minutes wrapped in paper towel to firm its shape, then slice.

recipes.name: Nikujaga (beef and potato stew)
recipes.blurb: Japanese home-style beef, potato and carrot simmered in a sweet soy broth.
method: Rinse the rice until the water runs almost clear. Put it in a pot with 1.2 times its volume of water, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave it covered off the heat for 10 minutes.
Fry the onion in the oil for 2 minutes, then add the beef and cook until browned.
Add the potato and carrot, the stock, sugar and mirin. Bring to the boil and skim.
Cover with a lid a little smaller than the pan (or a circle of baking paper) and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and simmer for 10 minutes more until the potatoes are tender and the broth has reduced by about half.
Add the peas for the last 2 minutes. Serve in bowls with the rice.

recipes.name: Pad thai with prawns
recipes.blurb: Rice noodles stir-fried with prawns, egg and tofu, finished with peanuts, bean sprouts and lime.

ingredients.note: or 2 tbsp tamarind paste if you have it

method: Soak the noodles in warm water for 20 to 30 minutes until bendy but still firm, then drain.
Mix the fish sauce, sugar, the juice of 1 lime, the vinegar and chilli powder.
Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a wok over high heat. Fry the tofu for 3 minutes until golden, then add the garlic and prawns and stir-fry for 2 minutes until the prawns turn pink.
Push everything to one side, add the rest of the oil, crack in the eggs and scramble them.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes until the noodles are soft and the sauce is absorbed. Add a splash of water if it looks dry.
Toss through the bean sprouts and spring onion for 30 seconds. Serve with the peanuts and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Thai green chicken curry
recipes.blurb: Chicken and vegetables simmered in coconut milk with green curry paste, basil and lime.

ingredients.note: Thai basil if you can find it

method: Rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.
Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute. Add 200 ml of the coconut milk (the thick part from the top of the can) and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes, then pour in the rest of the coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the zucchini and capsicum and simmer for 5 minutes until just tender.
Season with the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice. Stir in the basil leaves and serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Red curry with pumpkin and tofu
recipes.blurb: A rich coconut curry with sweet pumpkin, tofu and spinach. Most curry pastes contain shrimp paste, so check the label for vegetarians.
method: Rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.
Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute, then add 200 ml of the coconut milk and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the pumpkin and the rest of the coconut milk and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes until the pumpkin is tender.
Add the tofu and simmer for 3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Season with the soy sauce, sugar and lime juice, add the basil and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Tom yum soup with prawns
recipes.blurb: Hot and sour prawn soup fragrant with lemongrass, chilli and lime.

ingredients.note: sliced (galangal if you can find it)

method: Bash the lemongrass with a rolling pin and cut it into 5 cm lengths.
Simmer the stock with the lemongrass, ginger and chilli for 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and tomato and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the prawns and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until pink and cooked through.
Take off the heat and season with the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice: it should taste sour, salty and spicy. Add the coriander. The lemongrass and ginger pieces are not eaten.

recipes.name: Tom kha gai (coconut chicken soup)
recipes.blurb: A gentle, creamy coconut soup with chicken, mushroom, lemongrass and lime.

ingredients.note: sliced (galangal if you can find it)

method: Bash the lemongrass and cut it into 5 cm lengths. Simmer it in the stock with the ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and chicken and simmer gently, without boiling hard, for 6 to 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Add the mushrooms and chilli and simmer for 3 minutes.
Take off the heat and season with the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar. Add the coriander. Leave the lemongrass and ginger pieces in the bowl.

recipes.name: Thai basil chicken (pad kra pao)
recipes.blurb: Spicy chopped chicken stir-fried with garlic, chilli and basil, topped with a crispy fried egg.
method: Rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.
Pound or finely chop the garlic and chilli together.
Heat 2 tbsp of the oil until very hot and fry the eggs one at a time until the edges are crisp. Keep them warm.
Heat the rest of the oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds, then the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked.
Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water and toss for a minute.
Stir through the basil until it wilts. Serve over rice with a fried egg on top.

recipes.name: Thai beef salad
recipes.blurb: Seared beef tossed with crunchy vegetables, herbs and a sharp lime and chilli dressing.
method: Dressing: mix the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, chilli and garlic.
Sear the beef in the oil in a very hot pan, in batches, for 1 to 2 minutes until browned outside and still pink inside. Rest for 3 minutes and toss with 2 tbsp of the dressing.
Combine the lettuce, cucumber, tomato, onion, spring onion and coriander.
Add the beef and the rest of the dressing, toss, and top with the peanuts.

recipes.name: Pork larb lettuce cups
recipes.blurb: Zesty minced pork with lime, chilli and herbs, eaten in crisp lettuce leaves.

ingredients.note: 2 tbsp for toasting, the rest to serve
mint is traditional if you have it

method: Dry-toast 2 tbsp of the uncooked rice in a frying pan, stirring, for about 5 minutes until deep golden. Crush it finely.
Cook the rest of the rice: rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.
Fry the pork in the oil over medium-high heat, breaking it up, for about 6 minutes until cooked. Add 2 tbsp water and take off the heat.
Stir in the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and chilli, then the onion, spring onion, herbs and most of the toasted rice.
Spoon into lettuce leaves, sprinkle with the rest of the toasted rice and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Chicken satay with peanut sauce
recipes.blurb: Grilled coconut-marinated chicken skewers with a homemade peanut sauce. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
method: Mix the chicken with 100 ml of the coconut milk, the curry powder, 1 tbsp of the sugar and 1 tbsp of the fish sauce. Marinate for at least 30 minutes. Soak wooden skewers in water at the same time.
Rinse the rice, then simmer it in twice its volume of water with a pinch of salt, covered, for about 12 minutes until tender. Keep covered.

Peanut sauce: blitz or very finely chop the peanuts. Simmer the rest of the coconut milk with the curry paste for 2 minutes, then add the peanuts, the rest of the sugar, the soy sauce and the rest of the fish sauce. Simmer, stirring, for 5 minutes until thick. Add the lime juice and loosen with water if needed.
Thread the chicken onto the skewers, brush with the oil and grill, barbecue or pan-fry for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until cooked through and charred in places.
Serve with the peanut sauce, cucumber and rice.

recipes.name: Pad see ew (stir-fried rice noodles with chicken)
recipes.blurb: Wide rice noodles stir-fried until slightly charred with chicken, broccoli, egg and soy.

ingredients.note: a dash of dark soy sauce too if you have it

method: Soak the noodles in warm water until bendy, then drain (fresh wide rice noodles just need separating).
Mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Fry the garlic for 15 seconds, then the chicken for 4 minutes until cooked.
Add the broccoli stems, then the florets, with a splash of water and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Push everything aside and scramble the eggs in the space.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss, letting the noodles sit for 30 seconds at a time so they char a little, for about 3 minutes. Finish with the pepper.
